name: NCAA D-II South Central Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Lubbock, TX · Chaparral Ridge · host Lubbock Christian
headline: South Central Regional: 17 ranked teams, one loaded race
summary: Eight ranked men’s teams, led by No. 2 Adams State, No. 3 Colorado School of Mines and No. 6 West Texas A&M, and nine ranked women’s teams, led by No. 2 Western Colorado, No. 3 Adams State and No. 4 Mines, chase spots at the D-II championship. Mines’ Dawson Gunn won the RMAC title by 9.4 seconds.
